outbreaks.description: Hepatitis E, informal settlement water supply
Acute watery diarrhoea after a water-supply interruption

readmission_model.note: logit = intercept + age65 + age45_64 + chronic + 0.04*min(LOS,30) + weekend/Friday discharge + AMA + self-pay + frailty (latent, unobserved) + maternity; observed flag also contains chance readmissions

truth.ed_wait_model: door-to-doctor = triage median (RED 2, ORANGE 8, YELLOW 42, GREEN 125 min) x exp(1.4*(arrivals per hour / (doctors on duty x 1.6) - 0.8)) x (1 + 1.6*max(0, hospital occupancy - 0.90)) x 1.10 at night x lognormal(0, 0.55)
truth.staffing_intervention: From 5 Jan 2026 Rundu, Katima Mulilo and Nkurenkuru received 25% agency nurse hours; the Rundu and Katima EDs had one extra day-shift doctor from 5 Jan to 30 Jun 2026.
truth.malaria_model: daily cases = base(facility) x season amplitude x (rain 21-56 days earlier / Jan-May mean)^1.3; imported cases follow the north-east curve with a 7-day lag
